data.body: [P1] Bind the approved release to the checkout commit. The new gate asks reviewers to check the release tag, but checkout still receives the unqualified `github.event.release.tag_name`. The pinned checkout's `getCheckoutInfo` prefers a matching branch over a tag. If someone creates a branch with the release tag's name, the tag can remain immutable and on `main` while this approved job builds and publishes the branch's code with `id-token: write`. Set checkout's `ref` to `${{ github.sha }}` and have the reviewer verify that same commit, so approval and publishing use identical source. Include regression coverage for a branch/tag name collision.
